_about: What answers at each number the modem dials (PR#2, ATDT) and RUN WARDIAL
sweeps. Numbers are 555-01xx, the block set aside for fiction. Any number
not listed rings out, is busy, or a person answers, the same every time.
answers: computer (a carrier: CONNECT), fax, busy, voice (says: spoken).
Nobody is told these numbers; they turn up on the disk, the BBS, gopher.

555-0105.says: You again? Stop calling this number.

555-0183.says: Thank you for calling. Please hold.
